evaluation_procedure_001.evidence: ARTICLE XII: TEACHER EVALUATION. Both parties agree that the Superintendent is charged by law to establish procedures for assessing the performance of duties and responsibilities of all instructional personnel.

evaluation_system_002.answer: Classroom Instructional Employees’ Evaluation System and Non-Classroom Instructional Personnel Evaluation (NCIPE)
evaluation_system_002.evidence: The Classroom Instructional Employees’ Evaluation System and Handbook and the Non-Classroom Instructional Employees’ Evaluation System and Handbook shall be online.

evaluation_observation_count_003.evidence: All teachers must be evaluated annually. All probationary teachers shall receive an observation within the first forty-five (45) teaching days.

evaluation_ratings_005.evidence: Unsatisfactory final summative evaluation ratings. / final summative evaluation rating of less than “Effective”
